[SWS_LinTrcv_00130] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If called with Reason == NULL, the function LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason shall report
the development error LINTRCV_E_PARAM_POINTER.⌋
Configuration: The number of supported busses is statically set in the configuration
phase.
Caveats: Be aware that if more than one bus is available each bus may report a dif-
ferent wakeup reason. E.g. if an ECU has LIN, a wakeup by LIN may occur and the
incoming data may cause an internal wakeup for another LIN bus.
The LIN transceiver driver has a "per bus" view and does not vote the more important
reason or sequence internally. The same may be true if e.g. one transceiver controls
the power supply and the other is just powered or un-powered.
